metadata.scenario: A client calls to reschedule their physiotherapy session to another day due to a scheduling conflict. They confirm a new date and time with the receptionist. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Harold Gonzalez. I'm calling to reschedule my physical therapy session. Hi Harold! Of course, I can help you with that. When was your original appointment? It was scheduled for this Thursday at 10 AM. Got it. What day and time would work better for you? I have a scheduling conflict, so I would like to move it to next Monday at the same time, if possible. Let me check our schedule for next Monday at 10 AM. One moment, please. Yes, we have an opening at 10 AM next Monday. I can book that for you. That sounds perfect, thank you! You're welcome! Just to confirm, I’ll reschedule your physical therapy to next Monday at 10 AM. Yes, that’s correct. Great! Is there anything else I can assist you with while you're on the line? Well, I'm also wondering if there are any updates on my medication management. I can connect you with our medication management nurse. Would you like me to schedule a visit? Yes, please, that would be helpful. Perfect, I can arrange for Robert, our registered nurse, to visit you this week. That would be great! What day does he have available? He is available this Tuesday at 2 PM or Thursday at 1 PM. Let's go with Tuesday at 2 PM. Excellent choice! I’ll book that appointment for you with Robert. Thank you, Margaret. Is there any charge for this visit? Yes, the medication management visit is between $65 and $80, depending on the services provided. That sounds reasonable. Great! I’ll finalize both appointments for you: physical therapy on Monday at 10 AM and medication management on Tuesday at 2 PM. Thank you so much for your help! You’re very welcome, Harold! If you need anything else, don’t hesitate to call. I appreciate it. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
